name: Minh Thanh Pagoda
kicker: Hill pagoda with a 72 m tower
summary: Stop at Minh Thanh on a morning in Pleiku. Vietnam Tourism notes the hill pagoda was built in 1964, with a 72 m gold-painted tower, a po mu wood ceiling, and carved wooden doors. Give it about an hour. It is not Buu Minh pagoda on the road toward Chu Đăng Ya. Gate hours and donations are Check on arrival.
heroCaption: The gold-painted tower and the pagoda roofs above Pleiku

notice.title: Not Buu Minh pagoda
notice.body: Buu Minh sits on the road toward Chu Đăng Ya. Minh Thanh is the gold tower on the hill above Pleiku. They are different sites.

body: The tower is the landmark above town. Vietnam Tourism describes a 72 m gold-painted tower, a ceiling of po mu wood, and carved wooden doors on a pagoda built in 1964. Walk the grounds in daylight so the tower and the roofs stay in one view. About an hour covers the complex.

A short taxi from central Pleiku is the way up. Vietnam Tourism does not print the minutes or the fare. Both are Check on arrival. Save the volcano road for Chu Đăng Ya. The pagoda named along that road is Buu Minh, and it is not this hill.

figures.caption: The main hall, stair, and carved roof
figures.alt: Wooden hall of Minh Thanh Pagoda with a tiled roof, guardian lions, and a brick stair

gettingThere: Minh Thanh stands on the hill above Pleiku. Vietnam Tourism calls it a short taxi from the center. The feature does not print minutes or a fare. Both are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Pleiku
legs.body: By taxi from the center. Vietnam Tourism calls the ride short and does not print minutes or a fare. Both are Check on arrival.

admissionNote: Gate hours and donations are Check on arrival. Vietnam Tourism describes the tower, the po mu ceiling, and the carved doors. It does not print a ticket price or a child rule.
